scenicChapters.title: Achenpass
scenicChapters.narrative: Slow enough to look. The surface follows the shoreline, so the corners arrive where the water decided, not where an engineer did. Water arrives beside the road and stays for 56 km. The line follows the shore because there is nowhere else for it to go.
scenicChapters.riderNote: Check the pass is open before you commit to it.

german-alpine-road-walchensee-berchtesga.story: A 204 km one-way ride from near Schlehdorf, about 3 h 20 of riding. The stops in between: Tegernsee and Reit im Winkl. The highest point is about 1,250 m. A steady touring day rather than a sprint.
